title: Three Cup Chicken (San Bei Ji)
rawIngredients: 1 1/2 tbsp plain oil (canola, vegetable, or peanut)
600g chicken thighs, boneless, skinless, cut into 2.5cm pieces
1 cup lightly packed Thai basil leaves
2 tbsp Chinese cooking wine or Taiwanese rice wine (mijiu)
method: Toast the sliced ginger and dried chillies in plain oil for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken pieces and sear to seal, adding the minced garlic toward the end.
Pour in the light soy, dark soy, sugar, and cooking wine.
Braise over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the sauce reduces to a syrupy glaze.
Turn off the heat, stir in the toasted sesame oil and fresh Thai basil leaves until wilted, then serve with white rice.
